units.title: Count ordered tuples of three sixth roots
units.statement: The roots of z cubed minus 2z squared plus 2z minus 1 are 1 and two conjugate sixth roots. Each seventh power equals the root itself. A real target sum fixes equal counts of the conjugate pair, after which a multinomial coefficient counts ordered tuples.
steps: Factor the cubic into a linear and quadratic factor
Use seventh powers and compare imaginary parts
Solve for the three root multiplicities and count their arrangements
